evals.prompt: Add a setup script to this repo: evals/files/fullstack. The Azure tenant ID is 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555.
evals.expected_output: Enters plan mode, detects every tool from the repo files, asks what else to install, and writes a new setup.ps1 from the skeleton with the .NET SDK 9, Aspire CLI, nvm with Node 22, pnpm through corepack, Azure CLI, Functions Core Tools, GitHub CLI, the Claude CLI, both sign-ins, the Claude plugins, the ASD-STE100 skill, pnpm and dotnet restore, and dotnet tool restore.
expectations: Enters plan mode (or states it calls EnterPlanMode) before any file edit
The plan names each step by its tool or action (for example "Node 22 through nvm"), and never by a table row number
Asks the developer whether anything else should be installed that the detection did not find
Installs .NET SDK 9 (from global.json) through winget ID Microsoft.DotNet.SDK.9
Installs the Aspire CLI only after a y/N prompt, because the installer is a remote script
Installs nvm for Windows and Node 22 (from src/client/.nvmrc), and enables pnpm through corepack
Installs the Azure CLI, Azure Functions Core Tools, and the GitHub CLI with Install-WithWinget
Signs in to Azure with a tenant comparison against 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555, and signs in to GitHub with gh auth status / gh auth login
Installs the Claude CLI only after a y/N prompt, because the installer is a remote script

Adds the Claude marketplaces claude-plugins-official, elitebusinesssolutions, and ponytail, and installs each baseline plugin with claude plugin install --scope user, and runs claude plugin update --scope user (not a skip) for any that claude plugin list --json already shows, adding a manual line when an update fails

Does not add the chele-bi marketplace or the asd-ste100@chele-bi plugin, and installs the ASD-STE100 skill with npx skills add danyuchn/asd-ste100-skill -a claude-code after a y/N prompt, and skips it when ~/.claude/skills/asd-ste100/SKILL.md exists
Restores src/client with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, runs dotnet restore on src/server/Acme.slnx, and runs dotnet tool restore
Includes the elevation block and prints a summary of done, skipped, and manual steps
The script has no switch-back to the default Node major, because the repo has one Node major
Adds a Developer machine setup section to README.md
Does not run setup.ps1, and parses it (or states the parse check) as the verification

evals.prompt: Add the web app to the setup script in this repo: evals/files/existing-script. Nothing else needs to be installed.
evals.expected_output: Extends the existing setup.ps1 in its own style: keeps the existing .NET check, adds nvm with Node 20 and an npm ci restore for web, and asks whether to also add the detected GitHub CLI and sign-in, Claude CLI, Claude plugins, and ASD-STE100 skill instead of adding them unasked. Adds no Azure or corepack step.
expectations: Enters plan mode (or states it calls EnterPlanMode) before any file edit
The plan names each step by its tool or action (for example "Node 20 through nvm"), and never by a table row number
Keeps the existing .NET SDK check and the existing summary lines, and does not add a second .NET SDK install step
Does not rewrite or rename the existing code in setup.ps1
Adds nvm for Windows and Node 20 (from engines.node >=20 in web/package.json)
Restores web with npm ci, and does not add a corepack or pnpm step

Asks the developer whether to also add the GitHub CLI, the GitHub sign-in, the Claude CLI, the Claude plugins, and the ASD-STE100 skill (detected, but outside the request), and does not add them without an answer
Does not add the Azure CLI or an Azure sign-in, because the repo has no Azure dependency
Does not run setup.ps1

evals.prompt: Create setup.ps1 for this repo: evals/files/extras. Also install Docker Desktop.
evals.expected_output: Writes a new setup.ps1 with nvm and Node 20, npm ci, the GitHub CLI and sign-in, the Claude CLI, the Claude plugins, the ASD-STE100 skill, and Docker Desktop through winget, with no .NET or Azure steps.
expectations: Enters plan mode (or states it calls EnterPlanMode) before any file edit
The plan names each step by its tool or action (for example "Node 20 through nvm"), and never by a table row number
Adds Docker Desktop with Install-WithWinget and the winget ID Docker.DockerDesktop, before the sign-in steps
Adds nvm for Windows and Node 20 (from .nvmrc), and restores with npm ci
Does not add a .NET SDK, Aspire, Functions Core Tools, or Azure step
Adds the GitHub CLI install and the GitHub sign-in step
Adds the Claude CLI, the Claude plugins (user scope), and the ASD-STE100 skill steps
The script has no switch-back to the default Node major, because the repo has one Node major
Does not run setup.ps1
